entities.summary: Meher Afroz Shaon is a Bangladeshi architect, actress, director, dancer and playback singer. She won Bangladesh National Film Award for Best Female Playback Singer for her performance in the film Krishnopokkho (2016). She was the second wife of writer and director Humayun Ahmed.
